summary: InterCure Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing the initial closing of its acquisition of Botanico Ltd. (ISHI), an Israeli cannabis technology and brand company. The first tranche involves issuing 2,471,061 ordinary shares, with an additional 2,470,073 shares to be issued upon satisfaction of conditions. The company also initiated a strategic review of U.S. medical cannabis opportunities following federal rescheduling. The acquisition provides exclusive rights to U.S. cannabis genetics, brands, and AI-driven technologies. No advisors or premium were disclosed. Watch for regulatory milestones and integration progress.
